title: Expiry Reminder Goodwill Schedule — Builder Extended Rate Lock Waivers
content:
Goodwill is added to a builder-delay waiver on a Builder Extended Rate Lock when the buyer's expiry reminder was missing or late.

**Schedule.** The reminder lead is the calendar days from the latest expiry reminder on the lock ledger to the last day of the lock before its expired date. Where the ledger carries no expiry reminder, the goodwill is USD 300.00; where the reminder lead is shorter than the term's expiry reminder days, it is USD 150.00; otherwise it is zero. The goodwill is added to the waiver after the waiver percent of the extension charge has been rounded to the cent.

## Expiry reminder days by term

| Lock term | Expiry reminder days |
|---|---|
| 60-Day Standard Lock | 10 |
| 90-Day Lock | 10 |
| 120-Day Extended Lock | 10 |
| 180-Day Extended Lock | 15 |
| 270-Day Build Lock | 15 |
| 360-Day Build Lock | 15 |

## Goodwill

| Lock ledger | Goodwill |
|---|---|
| no expiry reminder | USD 300.00 |
| latest expiry reminder with a lead shorter than the term's expiry reminder days | USD 150.00 |
| latest expiry reminder with a lead of the term's expiry reminder days or longer | none |

## Cases (hypothetical dates)

A 90-Day Lock with an expired date of 21 July, so its last day before the expired date was 20 July:

- latest expiry reminder 14 July: lead 6, shorter than 10, goodwill USD 150.00;
- latest expiry reminder 10 July: lead 10, goodwill none;
- no expiry reminder on the ledger: goodwill USD 300.00.
